findings.description: The fallback to `exc.__context__` treats any implicitly chained exception as the retry's underlying cause, so reraise can surface an unrelated exception that was being handled when TryAgain was raised.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a retried function raises a bare TryAgain (no explicit cause) while called from inside an unrelated `except` block, so TryAgain.__context__ is that unrelated exception. Mechanism: when retries are exhausted, the new branch sees a non-None cause and raises it instead of the TryAgain. Impact: the caller receives an unrelated exception from outer code rather than the retry outcome, which misleads debugging and can change caller error handling.
